newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fifteen Indonesians die as bus plunges into gorge.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen Indonesians die as bus plunges into gorge.

text.p: At least 15 passengers, including a number of small children, died and 28 people were injured when a bus plunged into a gorge on Sunday in Indonesia's West Java province, the official Antara news agency reported.
The agency said the accident happened just after midday near the village of Cijapati, about 60 km (40 miles) southeast of the provincial capital of Bandung. The cause of the accident was not given.
